title: Best cheap travel backpacks under €100 (2025) — ThriftyTrail
text: You do not need $200 to travel with one bag. Winner: Decathlon Forclaz Travel 500 (€89.99). It opens flat like a suitcase, has an internal divider, mesh pockets and a separate shoe compartment, plus a foam back with ventilation channels and a removable waist belt — comfort features usually absent at this price. The 10-year warranty with repairable parts in Decathlon workshops makes it the buy-it-for-life pick of the budget tier; the 1.7 kg weight and outdoorsy look are the tax you pay. Runner-up: CabinZero Classic 36 ($79.95). Absurdly light at 760 g, effectively immune to budget-airline sizers, 10-year warranty, and the huge single compartment swallows everything. Skip it if you need structure: there is no internal organization to speak of and no load-bearing support, so it rewards light packers. Verdict: organized value seekers take the Decathlon; gram-counting budget flyers take the CabinZero.
